$comment: [X4.4] Tavily MCP attach spec. Tier-2 VERIFIED-PUBLISHER (publisher `tavily-ai` — official Tavily MCP server from github.com/tavily-ai; X1.5/X1.8 evidence). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Real-time web search + extract + map + crawl. CC0-1.0.
title: Tavily Web Search & Extraction
description: Real-time web search, page extraction, site mapping, and crawling via the official Tavily MCP server.

env_vars.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Tavily API key (`tvly-…`). Issue from app.tavily.com; required for the local server to authenticate. Pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: DEFAULT_PARAMETERS
env_vars.description: Optional JSON object of default `tavily-search` parameters (e.g. include_images, max_results, search_depth) applied to every request unless overridden per call.

env_vars.name: TAVILY_HUMAN_ID
env_vars.description: Optional opaque end-user identifier forwarded as the `X-Human-Id` header for per-user analytics; hashed server-side (SHA-256). Prefer an internal ID over raw PII.

auth.recipe: sign up at app.tavily.com, then set TAVILY_API_KEY to your `tvly-…` key; the free tier works for basic search.

sample_tools.name: tavily-search
sample_tools.summary: Real-time web search with configurable depth, result count, and optional images.

sample_tools.name: tavily-extract
sample_tools.summary: Extract clean, structured content from one or more web-page URLs.

sample_tools.name: tavily-map
sample_tools.summary: Build a structured map of a website's pages from a root URL.

sample_tools.name: tavily-crawl
sample_tools.summary: Systematically crawl a website starting from a base URL.

known_limitations: Requires a Tavily API key (TAVILY_API_KEY); without it the local server cannot authenticate and every tool returns an auth error.
Search, extract, map, and crawl all consume Tavily API credits — high `max_results` or deep crawls draw down the account quota faster.
Results reflect live public-web content and Tavily's index freshness; extraction quality varies with page structure (JS-heavy or paywalled pages may return partial content).
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no destructive tools — search/extract/map/crawl are read-only web retrieval.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `tavily-ai`: { command: npx, args: [-y, tavily-mcp], env: { TAVILY_API_KEY: "tvly-..." } }.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `tavily-ai`, command `npx -y tavily-mcp`; set TAVILY_API_KEY in the env.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `tavily-ai` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); supply TAVILY_API_KEY via inputs.
